quotes.text: We had an absolutely fabulous time on the Adventuress for our company teambuilding event! It was spectacularly beautiful, luxurious and your husband and crew were the BEST! The day was so fun, the weather was perfect, and we wanted to stay longer — went we docked at the end and our team was still sitting on the ship not making an effort to exit! (that is a true compliment!) The food was excellent – the chicken pasta was yummy!

We had such a wonderful experience aboard the Catamaran. The boat is impeccable, the wood work below is gorgeous. We thought we were living like the lifestyles of the rich and famous! We took our dental team out for a sunset cruise, we saw dolphins and went under the Coronado Bridge. It was the best camaraderie we have ever done! The captain and crew were five star all around! I wish I was still on board right now!

Wow! I don’t even know where to begin with this review. Yesterday my husband and I were married on the Adventuress Luxury Catamaran. Heather was amazing at helping me coordinate everything. The staff were so kind and gracious. Captain Ken officiated the ceremony and was great! I could go on and on. If you are looking for a great wedding experience you have to consider this venue! First class all the way.

Sometimes when planning a company event, employee expectations can be challenging as everyone wants something different, but we received rave reviews by all!! We would definitely book again in a heartbeat and will highly recommend to anyone considering this for a fun and relaxing outing. All in all, an exceptional experience!!! Thank you very much for your hospitality.

The boat was extremely clean, there was plenty of sitting and standing room, they have very comfy bean bag type of seats on front deck, below is a kitchen with counters, a large table (where we had our food) and cushioned seats and the back of the boat. The two restrooms, and two large sleeping rooms are below the kitchen. A very enjoyable evening for us all
